description: This file contains SQL schema definitions and related objects for a repair management system, including table creation, type definitions, functions, triggers, policies for row level security, and setup for real-time updates via Postgres publications.

methods.name: public.set_updated_at
methods.description: Trigger function to automatically update 'updated_at' timestamp before row update.

methods.name: public.current_user_role
methods.description: Returns the role of the current authenticated user based on their profile.

methods.name: public.is_admin
methods.description: Returns true if the current user has the admin role.

methods.name: public.is_technician
methods.description: Returns true if the current user has the technician role.

methods.name: public.handle_new_user
methods.description: Automatically creates a profile record upon new user registration in auth.users.
